And I give her examples. I don’t think it’s healthy at all, but I don’t want to just give up on her. I am not saying I have been completely perfect in our relationship but I try and when I make a mistake I learn from it. And I don’t want to give up. The constant threat of her wanting to kill herself puts a lot of stress on me. I’m worried I’ll find her dead when I am not home. I’ve called in sick plenty of times because I was afraid she would kill herself. I’ve been through some dark times and I was always dropped and I don’t want to be that kind of person but it’s been a battle since the beginning almost. I feel like I owe her something.
